summary: PyAI for Startups puts a $10M pool behind 200+ voice-product startups. Three tiers: Launch $20,000 (400k Omni + 25k phone minutes), Growth $50,000 (1M Omni + 50k phone minutes), Scale $100,000 (2M Omni + 100k phone minutes). Credits cover the whole PyAI rate card and release in 12 monthly parts over a one-year term; unused credit rolls forward inside the term. Eligibility: building a voice product live or launching within six months, working website, under $10M raised, incorporated fewer than seven years ago, not a current PyAI customer on an annual contract. No card required.
claim_steps: Apply at pyai.com/startups with company, product, stage, funding, and a demo link, two-minute video, or deck.
A person reviews within five business days (two via partner VC/accelerator).
On acceptance, sign up or sign in with the same email — credits attach automatically; no card needed.
